name: Canali
why: Family-owned Italian suiting with the broadest US specialty footprint.
origin: Brothers Giovanni and Giacomo Canali, 1934 — family-owned Italian suiting ever since.
opview: States its commitment plainly: made in Italy, always, family-owned.

onething.n: verified — the house's own Kei line page, US site. Unlined and without internal structure, so the jacket follows the body instead of holding a shape against it. Named by the London shop floor when asked what Canali is known for, and retailers describe Kei as the signature block rather than a seasonal model

notes.ital: Family-run in Brianza since 1934, which puts it in the second rank of Italian tailoring by fame and the first by consistency. The register is Milanese: structured, sober, unshowy.

cities: NYC, Beverly Hills, Vegas boutiques · the specialty circuit — Boyds, Mitchells, M Penner, Oak Hall
